title: Page 25
transc:
conrri no definite plan of
offensive operations can be found
till we are strong enough
to make the Walden Applause


3.45 PM 
Doyle F.  Washn Aug 22nd 1862
The Umber seem to be moving the
mass of their forces towards Warrington to
turn Aarons right It is therefore important
that Avon's Corps should move up as
rapidly as possible Direct him & all
other commanders to subsist his men &
forage his animals as much as possible
on the country Kearney's
Trenton is already moving
out by Scotland Abel
this is for Argyle
